decision_conditions: The development hereby permitted must be begun not later than the end of three years from the date of this permission. Reason: To comply with the provisions of S.51 of the Planning & Compulsory Purchase Act 2004.

The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans:Location and Site Plan Existing Loft Plan Existing Roof Plan Existing and Proposed West & North Elevations Existing and Proposed East and South Elevations Existing and Proposed Long & Cross Sections Proposed First Floor Plan Proposed Loft Plan Proposed Roof Plan Proposed Rear Elevation Casement Windows Front Garden DetailsHardstand Cross SectionCopy of Window Quotation LetterHeritage Statement Executive SummaryHeritage StatementReason: For the avoidance of doubt and in the interests of proper planning.

The external surfaces of the development hereby permitted shall be constructed in the materials shown on the approved plans and supporting information. Reason: To ensure the satisfactory appearance of the development, preserve the character and appearance of the conservation area.
The second floor side gable window shall be fitted with obscure glazing and shall be retained as such for the duration of the development hereby permitted.Reason: To safeguard residential amenity.

The parking space shown on the approved plans shall not be brought into use until a vehicular crossover has been formally approved by the Highway Authority and constructed in full accordance with that approval.Reason: To safeguard pedestrian safety and maintain safe access to the site.
Notwithstanding the plans hereby approved, the new front garden wall shall not exceed 0.6 metres in height.Reason: To safeguard pedestrian safety and maintain safe access to the site.
application_type_full: Householder planning & demolition in a conservation area
description: Hip to gable roof extension involving two rear dormers, replacement of existing hardstanding with tiled path, new hardstanding for single car space with associated crossover and front wall.
